featured.name: CaterNest
featured.intro: A marketplace connecting businesses with caterers — where ordering used to mean phone calls and PDF menus. I built the AI layer that removes that friction on both sides.
business: **Conversational ordering:** customers describe what they need in plain English — the assistant finds matching caterers, browses menus, and helps assemble orders
**Menu digitization in minutes:** caterers upload a PDF or photo of their menu and it becomes a structured, searchable listing — replacing hours of manual data entry per vendor
**Faster supply onboarding + natural-language discovery** — lowering the barrier for vendors to join and for buyers to find them
technical: **Agent orchestration:** LangGraph multi-step agent on AWS Bedrock (Claude), with tool-calling into search, menus, and order context
**Semantic search:** hybrid keyword + vector retrieval over OpenSearch indices for caterers, menus, and packages
**Persistent memory:** LangGraph PostgreSQL checkpointer so conversations survive across sessions
**PII-safe streaming:** server-sent-event token streaming with personal data filtered before it reaches the client
**Menu extraction pipeline:** AWS Textract OCR + LLM structuring converts raw menu documents into normalized catalog data
**Infra:** containerized services on ECS Fargate, Redis caching, IAM-scoped access

featured.name: PolicyGuard
featured.tagline: AI Compliance & Safeguarding Engine for Schools
featured.intro: A safeguarding and compliance platform for schools, where policy reviews, incident reporting, and supplier checks are slow, manual, and high-stakes. I built the AI engine behind it: a suite of services that scans, rewrites, and triages in minutes, while a person still signs off on every decision that matters.
business: **Policy compliance scans:** scores a school's policies against the current legislation register, lists the gaps, rewrites the policy to close them, and suggests refresher training for staff

**Incident & complaint triage:** classifies seriousness from the free-text report and proposes the right escalation and statutory deadline, built to escalate when in doubt and never to downgrade on its own
**Risk & verification:** excursion risk assessments, supplier certificate checks, CV parsing with candidate briefings, and audits of a school's public online exposure
**AI tool safety scanner:** grades AI tools a school wants to adopt against published AI-in-education frameworks, with evidence for each finding
technical: **Async job engine:** FastAPI with ARQ/Redis workers; each service queues the work, returns a job ID at once, and streams staged progress over SSE with cancel and retry
**Hybrid RAG on Qdrant:** dense + sparse retrieval over legislation and framework libraries, scoped by jurisdiction and category, in separate collections so policy and framework text never mix
**Document AI:** Docling parsing of PDF/DOCX into chunked, embedded indexes, with stale chunks evicted when a document is replaced
**Contract-first outputs:** Pydantic-validated JSON per service against a written contract, so the backend can switch from mock to live with a config flag
**Reproducibility & evals:** every scan records its prompt version, model, and engine build; an eval harness replays labelled cases to catch regressions
**Cost governance:** per-request token and cost tracking across models served through OpenRouter, attributed per school

featured.name: IsleWay
featured.intro: A travel platform for exploring Mediterranean island destinations. Static destination content doesn't answer a traveler's actual questions — so I built an AI companion that does.
business: **Interactive concierge:** travelers ask about destinations, itineraries, and logistics in natural language and get grounded answers from the platform's curated knowledge
**Higher engagement:** turns a content site into a conversation — keeping users planning inside the platform instead of leaving to search elsewhere
**Cost-aware by design:** built-in usage tracking keeps AI spend predictable as the audience grows
technical: **Agentic chat service:** FastAPI backend with a clean route → controller → service architecture and a dedicated travel agent module
**Knowledge retrieval:** curated destination knowledge base powering grounded, on-brand answers
**Production hygiene:** request tracing with per-request IDs, structured logging, uniform response envelopes, centralized error handling
**Quality gates:** strict typing (mypy --strict), linting, and pre-commit hooks; background workers for async jobs
**Cross-platform client:** Flutter app (clean architecture) consuming the AI APIs
